title: What the Fire Leaves
logline: A dry-zone family sows a paddy field, tends it through drought and pests, and waits to see whether the season ends in harvest or ruin.
human_question: How many different forces have to go right, one after another, for anything to come to fruit?

premise.story: A paddy-farming family followed through one full growing season, from ploughing to whatever the harvest actually turns out to be.
premise.place: A dry-zone paddy village dependent on a seasonal tank or rains.
premise.experience: Mud and water at the start, the long wait through the growing months, a dry spell or a pest outbreak, and the specific tension of the final weeks before harvest.

concept_links.why: The source's own image for its four kinds of kamma is exactly this: sowing a field, tending it, a drought that weakens the crop, then a fire that ends it [C055-P:L127]. The film can follow a real season and let the viewer feel the forces at work without the concept ever being named.

what_camera_could_observe: A dry spell or pest damage
The family's own account of a hard season
what_must_be_real: A real family's real season, with its real financial stakes. The film does not know in advance whether the harvest will succeed.

possible_arc.opening: Water let into a prepared field, seed going in.
possible_arc.turn: A dry spell, a pest, or some other setback threatens the crop.
possible_arc.ending_open: Harvest, partial harvest, or loss, whichever the season actually brings.

requirements: A paddy-farming family willing to be followed across a full growing season
Access to a dry-zone irrigation tract

suggestions.name: A village in the Polonnaruwa district
suggestions.why: An established dry-zone paddy-farming area with tank-fed irrigation.
suggestions.verify: No specific family or field identified.

risks: Turning a family's crop loss into a moral lesson
Implying hardship reflects the family's own past actions
Filming across a season requires a long, patient production schedule
drop_if: No family will commit to being filmed across an entire season
The season is too uneventful or too catastrophic to tell honestly

connections.note: A second, different-scale story about a growing season and what happens when the rain does not come.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
